title: Cambridge IELTS 15 Academic Speaking Test 1
description: Haqiqiy IELTS/CEFR Speaking formati: Rasmiy Cambridge IELTS 15 Test 1 bo‘yicha Part 1 (Kirish va kundalik mavzular), Part 2 (Cue Card taqdimot) va Part 3 (Tahliliy munozara).

sections.title: Speaking Assessment (Parts 1-3)
sections.instructions: Ushbu bo‘lim 3 ta qismdan iborat. Har bir qism topshirig‘i bilan tanishib chiqing, tayyor bo‘lgach mikrofon tugmasini bosib ovozingizni yozing va saqlang.

questions.question_text:
Part 1: Introduction & Everyday Topics (Speak for 1-2 minutes)

1. What kinds of emails do you receive about your work or studies?
2. Do you prefer to email, phone, or text your friends? [Why?]
3. Do you reply to emails and messages as soon as you receive them? [Why/why not?]
4. Are you happy to receive emails that are advertising things? [Why/why not?]

Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking)

Describe a hotel that you know
You should say:
• Where this hotel is
• What this hotel looks like
• What facilities this hotel has
And explain whether you think this is a nice hotel to stay in.

Part 3: Two-way Discussion (Speak for 2-3 minutes)

1. What things are important when people are choosing a hotel?
2. Why do some people not like staying in hotels?
3. Do you think staying in a luxury hotel is a waste of money?
4. Do you think hotel work is a good career for life?
5. How does working in a big hotel compare with working in a small hotel?
6. What skills are needed to be a successful hotel manager?
